summary: Examples of with_items looping over literals, adding several users, looping a variable, and using dicts with name, uid and groups.
questions: How do I create several users with a loop?
How do I loop over a list of dicts with with_items?
How do I loop over a list variable with with_items?

answer_card.title: with_items examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item }}"
    groups: "wheel"
    state: present
  with_items:
    - testuser1
    - testuser2

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "An item: {{ item }}"
  with_items: "{{ somelist }}"

- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    uid: "{{ item.uid }}"
    groups: "{{ item.groups }}"
    state: present
  with_items:
    - { name: testuser1, uid: 1002, groups: "wheel, staff" }
    - { name: testuser2, uid: 1003, groups: staff }
```
